item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Collaborative construction processes within a multi-system robotic architecture - 2026_CDR_DABC_6 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-08 Design, tecnologia dell'architettura, architettura tecnica e gestione dell'ambiente costruito

The research program includes the following activities: - Support for the executive design, integration, and implementation of a full-scale multi-system robotic prototype for collaborative construction processes. - Study of the integration between virtual and physical environments for the simulation, monitoring, and coordination of robotic operations. - Support for the design and optimization of end-effectors and manipulation systems, component selection, and hardware and software integration. - Experimental testing, performance analysis, and system optimization through adaptive control and error recovery strategies. - Assessment of safety, human-robot interaction, and support for TRL 4…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Structural monitoring and digitalization for bridge maintenance planning - 2026_CDR_DABC_4 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2027-11-14 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-07 Tecnica delle costruzioni

The project focuses on the development and validation of innovative, low-cost, large-scale, and automated technologies for collecting and utilizing information related to the structural health of bridges in support of decision relevnt to seismic performance management. The work will be carried out within the framework of the BRIDGITISE project (Doctoral Network on Bridge Digitalised Integrity Management), ID 101119554, funded by the European Commission under the HORIZON TMA MSCA Doctoral Networks – Industrial Doctorates program.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Behavioural models, incentives and data-driven methods for sustainable urban logistics in the NEXTLOGIC project (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-12 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

The research concerns the definition of a scientific and methodological framework for analysing the behaviour of users, logistics operators, and urban stakeholders, and for the co-design of incentive strategies and reward mechanisms aimed at supporting the transition towards sustainable, net-zero urban logistics systems.
